notes: Large-source-unit check on בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר → *whithersoever*: the one English word carries the relation (*whither*), the universality (*-soever*) and the relative (*wher-*), so rule 30's one-English-word condition is met for every morpheme and the grouping is genuinely indivisible; any split would leave a morpheme with no rendering. Retained, headed on the relative with כֹּל named as the competing head.
*to the right hand* / *to the left* are adverbial accusatives whose supplied *to* and *the* belong to the nouns (rules 33, 15), headed on *right* and *left* by rule 31's subtraction test.
*according to* is one compound preposition on כְּ, headed on *according* (rule 24).
